stories.title: JSO investigating after man found dead inside home on Jacksonville's Westside
stories.summary: The Jacksonville Sheriff's Office said the circumstances surrounding the incident are unknown and are being investigated.

stories.title: Fleming Island father raises money for daughter's headstone with Lynyrd Skynyrd guitar fundraiser
stories.summary: A Fleming Island father is raising $4,000 for his 16-year-old daughter’s music-note headstone through a fundraiser featuring a guitar signed by Johnny Van Zant.

stories.title: No charges to be filed after 14-year-old on e-moto killed in Clay County crash
stories.summary: The Florida Highway Patrol determined that the other drivers were not at fault for the June 11 death of a 14-year-old rider on Sandridge Road.

stories.title: City of St. Augustine monitoring weather conditions ahead of annual Light-Up! Night celebration
stories.summary: Potential flooding and safety concerns could dampen St. Augustine's annual Nights of Lights kickoff.

stories.title: Two men quickly arrested after body discovered inside trunk in St. Augustine
stories.summary: Deputies and officers responded to where the body was found Wednesday morning, but said the victim was shot and killed elsewhere during an argument.

stories.title: Diagnosed at 46, Jacksonville mom shares early-onset Alzheimer's journey
stories.summary: Staci Marklin is raising her 4-year-old son while navigating life with early-onset Alzheimer's.

stories.title: Vandeveer opens as first residential building in downtown Jacksonville's Pearl Square
stories.summary: The 205-bedroom residential building will eventually be a part of a 1500-unit, walkable neighborhood in downtown Jacksonville.

stories.title: St. Marys city manager raises concerns over ICE detentions impacting the new city hall
stories.summary: The St. Marys city manager said during a recent public City Council meeting that ICE operations took about 30 workers from the new City Hall, delaying progress.

stories.title: Man convicted of Jacksonville 17-year-old's 1985 murder sentenced to life in prison
stories.summary: David Nelson Austin, 65, was found guilty of first-degree murder, two counts of armed kidnapping and armed sexual battery in relation to the death of Leslie McCray.

stories.title: Search underway for Good Samaritan who helped save Ponte Vedra teacher's life after fishing accident
stories.summary: Greg Arcuri was cleaning fish near Aunt Kate's Restaurant in St. Augustine when a knife slipped and cut through his femoral artery and vein.

stories.title: Fort White woman killed in head-on collision on Wilson Springs Road: FHP
stories.summary: The 45-year-old woman reportedly drove an SUV into the wrong lane Wednesday afternoon and collided with a truck.

stories.title: Paid parking ends in downtown Fernandina Beach after months of controversy
stories.summary: Following a decisive rejection in a special election, paid parking in downtown Fernandina Beach ends.
